title: Frontend calls the second consignment party "Consignor or exporter"; Design release 1 calls it "Consignor"

finding.frontend: In the addresses section the party is called "Consignor or exporter": as the row label on the Consignment addresses page, as the h1 and breadcrumb of its picker, and in the visually hidden text of that row's Add and Change links (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy/copy.en.js:20-24). The hint beneath it, "This is the sender of the consignment.", is word for word Design release 1's. Elsewhere in the same service Frontend already calls the party "Consignor" — on the check-your-answers page (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/copy/copy.en.js:81), in the dashboard table (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/copy/copy.en.js:21) and in the picker's own error message — so a trader meets two names for one party depending on where they are standing.
finding.prototype: Design release 1 calls it "Consignor", with no "or exporter", on the addresses page and as the heading of its picker (app/data/consignment-address-sections.js:16-17, rendered as both the section heading and the picker h1). It carries the same hint. The other four parties — Place of origin, Consignee, Importer, Place of destination — are named identically on both sides, so this is the one party name that disagrees.
finding.difference: Rename the party to "Consignor" in the addresses copy (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy/copy.en.js:21 and its Welsh counterpart), which changes the addresses row label, the picker heading, the picker breadcrumb, the page title and the hidden link text together — that one string is the only place the phrase is authored (grep for "Consignor or exporter" across src/server returns copy.en.js:21 and two assertions in addresses/controller.test.js). Nothing else in the service has to move: the error message "Select a consignor from the list", the check-your-answers row and the dashboard column already say Consignor. The internal id, route slug and address-book role stay as they are — this is what the trader reads, not what the code calls it.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding "or exporter" anywhere in Design release 1's root views for this party. app/data/consignment-address-sections.js:17 sets the heading to "Consignor", and the captured DOM of dr1-consignment-address-select-consignor-or-exporter heads the page "Consignor".
finding.verification: Ran the falsifier wider than it asks: grep -rl 'or exporter' across the whole of the prototype's app/ returns nothing — not the root views, not the partials, not the data files, not routes.js (the hyphenated route id consignor-or-exporter is not the phrase). The captured DOMs agree: the h1 in capture/html/prototype/dr1-consignment-address-select-consignor-or-exporter.html is "Consignor" and in capture/html/frontend/fe-address-picker-consignor-or-exporter.html it is "Consignor or exporter". Checked the claim that this is the only party name that disagrees by reading all five headings on each side — app/data/consignment-address-sections.js:4, :17, :31, :44, :58 against src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy/copy.en.js:14-40 — and Place of origin, Consignee, Importer and Place of destination match word for word, hints included. Confirmed the error string already reads "Select a consignor from the list" at copy.en.js:23. Opened both page shots. Rubric 2 fired on the frontend slot — see correction.
finding.correction: The finding is right and the rename is right; the frontend slot said "everywhere it appears" and that is false, so the slot has been corrected. Frontend already calls this party "Consignor" in three places outside the addresses section: the check-your-answers row (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/copy/copy.en.js:81, and the tag-stripped fe-check-answers.html renders it as "Consignor"), the dashboard table column (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/copy/copy.en.js:21) and the picker's own validation message. So the disagreement with Design release 1 is real but it is also a disagreement inside Frontend, which makes the change smaller and more clearly right than the finding claimed: grep for the phrase "Consignor or exporter" across src/server returns one authored string, at addresses/copy/copy.en.js:21, plus two assertions in addresses/controller.test.js that move with it. The difference slot has been narrowed to that one line accordingly. One note on the crop, stated as an observation rather than a prediction because I did not run the anchor tool: "Consignor or exporter" appears three times in fe-address-picker-consignor-or-exporter.html — the document title, the breadcrumb's aria-current list item and the h1 — and only the h1 is a heading, the breadcrumb item being plain text rather than a link. On the requirements side the string does not exist by definition, which is the finding, so that card will show the whole page.
